result:
Perfect! ✅ All tests are now passing. 

**The bug was in `tally/invoice.py:42`**: The discount condition was using `>` instead of `>=`, which prevented the bulk discount from applying at exactly 10 units. The fix changes:

```python
if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:  # Wrong: only applies when units > 10
```

to:

```python
if self.units() >= BULK_UNITS:  # Correct: applies when units >= 10
```

This allows the 5% bulk discount to kick in starting at 10 units, as the test "test_bulk_discount_starts_at_ten_units" expects.
